                                                   Sahil Bhola∗

                                       Last Edited: September 10, 2026



1        Floating-Point Model
We assume the standard floating-point model [1]: for every elementary operation ◦ ∈ {+, −, ×, /},
                                      fl(a ◦ b) = (a ◦ b)(1 + δ),   |δ| ≤ u,                       (1)
where u is the unit roundoff and δ is the relative roundoff error. Using eq. (1) for numerical analysis
we typicall obtain the product
                                Yn
                                    (1 + δi )ρi ≜ 1 + θn ,    ρ = ±1,                               (2)
                                       i=1
where n denotes the number of accumulated roundoff error terms. For numerical analysis, we seek
reliable and sharp bounds for θn .


2        Deterministic Rounding Error Analysis
The deterministic rounding error analysis proposes the following problem-size dependent constant
                                                  nu
                                          γn ≜         ,                                      (3)
                                                1 − nu
for nu < 1. Here, n is the number of accumulated error terms [1]. The problem-size dependent
constant is monotonic, that is, γn+1 > γn for u > 0. Performing backward/forward error analysis
using eq. (3) we obtain
                                                     |θn | ≤ γn .                                  (4)

    12	  | add : Tree → Tree → ℝ → Tree

    17	def leaves : Tree → List ℝ
    18	  | .leaf x => [x]
    19	  | .add a b _ => leaves a ++ leaves b
    20	
    21	def eval : Tree → ℝ
    22	  | .leaf x => x
    23	  | .add a b d => (eval a + eval b) * (1 + d)
    24	
    25	def depth : Tree → ℕ
    26	  | .leaf _ => 0
    27	  | .add a b _ => max (depth a) (depth b) + 1
    28	
    29	def Valid (u : ℝ) : Tree → Prop
    30	  | .leaf _ => True
    31	  | .add a b d => Valid u a ∧ Valid u b ∧ |d| ≤ u

    33	/-- One pair per input occurrence, even if several inputs have equal values. -/
    34	def terms : Tree → List (ℝ × ℝ)
    35	  | .leaf x => [(x, 1)]
    36	  | .add a b d => (terms a ++ terms b).map (fun p => (p.1, p.2 * (1 + d)))

    38	@[simp] theorem terms_inputs (t : Tree) : (terms t).map Prod.fst = leaves t := by
    39	  induction t with
    40	  | leaf x => simp [terms, leaves]
    41	  | add a b d ha hb => simpa [terms, leaves, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using congrArg₂ List.append ha hb
    42	
    43	theorem eval_terms (t : Tree) :
    44	    t.eval = ((terms t).map (fun p => p.1 * p.2)).sum := by
    45	  induction t with
    46	  | leaf x => simp [eval, terms]
    47	  | add a b d ha hb =>
    48	    simp only [eval, terms, List.map_append, List.map_map, List.sum_append]
    49	    rw [ha, hb, add_mul]
    50	    simp only [Function.comp_def, ← mul_assoc]
    51	    simp [← List.sum_map_mul_right]

    53	end Tree
    54	
    55	/-- A simultaneous level, with zero-based indices. The offset is the
    56	ceiling half-width. The unavailable-partner branch returns the old tree. -/
    57	def level (err : ℕ → ℝ) (ts : List Tree) : List Tree :=
    58	  let m := (ts.length + 1) / 2
    59	  ((ts.take m).zipIdx).map fun (a, k) =>
    60	    match ts[k + m]? with
    61	    | some b => .add a b (err k)
    62	    | none => a
    63	
    64	/-- Execute exactly the paper's ceiling-logarithm number of levels. -/
    65	def rounds (err : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → List Tree → List Tree
    66	  | 0, ts => ts
    67	  | k + 1, ts => level (err k) (rounds err k ts)

    69	def algorithm (xs : List ℝ) (err : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) : Option Tree :=
    70	  (rounds err (Nat.clog 2 xs.length) (xs.map Tree.leaf)).head?
    71	
    72	def gamma (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ := (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)

    75	theorem logarithmic_depth (n : ℕ) : Nat.clog 2 n = ⌈Real.logb 2 n⌉₊ := by
    76	  simpa using (Real.natCeil_logb_natCast 2 n).symm

    78	/-- A single relative error extends a coefficient's gamma bound. -/
    79	theorem gamma_step {k : ℕ} {u w d : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    80	    (hk : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u < 1)
    81	    (hw : |w - 1| ≤ gamma k u) (hd : |d| ≤ u) :
    82	    |w * (1 + d) - 1| ≤ gamma (k + 1) u := by

    98	      apply (le_div_iff₀ hden').2
    99	      field_simp

   105	    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hk : (k : ℝ) * u < 1)
   106	    (ht : t.depth ≤ k) (hv : t.Valid u) :
   107	    ∀ p ∈ t.terms, |p.2 - 1| ≤ gamma k u := by
   108	  induction k generalizing t with
   109	  | zero =>
   110	    cases t with
   111	    | leaf x => simp [Tree.terms, gamma]
   112	    | add a b d => simp [Tree.depth] at ht
   113	  | succ k ih =>
   114	    have hk' : (k : ℝ) * u < 1 := by push_cast at hk; nlinarith
   115	    cases t with
   116	    | leaf x =>
   117	      simp only [Tree.terms, List.mem_singleton]
   118	      intro p hp

   121	      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hu) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - ((k+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u)
   122	    | add a b d =>
   123	      rcases hv with ⟨ha, hb, hd⟩
   124	      have hdepth : a.depth ≤ k ∧ b.depth ≤ k := by simpa [Tree.depth, max_le_iff] using ht
   125	      intro p hp
   126	      simp only [Tree.terms, List.mem_map, List.mem_append] at hp
   127	      rcases hp with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
   128	      apply gamma_step hu hk _ hd
   129	      rcases hq with hq | hq
   130	      · exact ih a hk' hdepth.1 ha q hq
   131	      · exact ih b hk' hdepth.2 hb q hq

   148	    ring

   159	    (hadd : ∀ a b k, P a → P b → P (.add a b (err k))) :

   164	  have hamem : a ∈ ts := by
   165	    have hz := List.mem_zipIdx ha
   166	    apply List.mem_of_mem_take
   167	    exact List.mem_of_getElem hz.2.2.symm

   179	theorem rounds_depth (err : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (xs : List ℝ) :
   180	    ∀ t ∈ rounds err k (xs.map Tree.leaf), t.depth ≤ k := by

   182	  | zero =>
   183	    intro t ht
   184	    simp only [rounds, List.mem_map] at ht
   185	    rcases ht with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
   186	    simp [Tree.depth]
   187	  | succ k ih =>
   188	    intro t ht
   189	    change t ∈ level (err k) (rounds err k (xs.map Tree.leaf)) at ht

   191	    simp only [level, List.mem_map] at ht
   192	    rcases ht with ⟨⟨a, j⟩, ha, rfl⟩
